balls.text: Dot ball to finish and RCB have held MI back to 166. Chahar charged down the ground and Rasikh serves up a 106kph short ball. Chahar misses his swipe and they can't even attempt a bye. They do review it for wide on height but the players have started making their way back
Back of length outside off and jagging in. Puled away to deep midwicket on the bounce
Back of length ball, wide of off, stays low and goes under the bat as Bosch looks to slap it away
Full outside off, pace off at 103kph, Bosch wants to hit it big but the lack of pace does him in. In the end he just manages to whip it to deep midwicket's right
Full on the stumps, Chahar looks to whip it away but can't connect cleanly. Single to deep square leg
Length ball outside off, Bosch pulls it away off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg

Chipped to mid-off! This is an attempted yorker outside off but it turns into a full toss. Bawa looks to hit it down the ground but his bat turns in his hands as he makes contact. Easy catch for the RCB skipper and Hazlewood has a wicket to his name
Length ball angled across, he looks to swipe across the line and just gets a touch on it. They get a single as the ball goes towards short fine
Ouch! Slower bouncer around leg, an off-cutter, and Bawa misses his pull and is hit on the grill
Nails the leg-stump yorker. Bawa is able to dig it back out to the bowler
Nearly a mix-up! Bawa clips this length ball through square leg and takes a single. Bosch wanted a second and had taken off but Bawa was slow to start off. He makes it in safely in the end
Full on off and angled across, Bawa looks to swing it away but can't quite time it. However, they have enough time to run two without much risk as long-on runs to his left to gather

Oh, he's played that onto his stumps! Bhuvi has a fourth! Bhuvneshwar was looking for a seam-up yorker, and Tilak went across to scoop. But he doesn't get under the ball and gets an inside edge that deflects the ball onto the stumps. Bhuvneshwar ends his spell with a well deserved four-for
Low full toss on off, swung away through midwicket
On a length around middle and leg, punched back to the bowler
Clipped to deep midwicket
Oh, punched back past the bowler! Full outside off and Tilak meets it with a punchy straight- drive
Full and wide, angled across him. He looks to reach out and squeeze it away but can't connect
Looks for the loopy dipping yorker on off. Nearly nails it too at 106kph, but Bawa is able to punch it down towards long-on for two more
Another slower ball, on the stumps this time. Tucked into the vacant square leg region and they are able to run two again
Full outside off, slower ball, squeezed out on the off side. They pick up two
Eased through midwicket for a single

Back of length outside off and Tilak cuts it away in the gap at point. Fifty up in 37 balls for Tilak Varma. Not the first time he's had to do a rescue job for MI. He is their biggest hope today for a strong finish
Full outside leg, clipped through square leg. They do well to run two
Nicely played! Short ball outside off, he gets inside the line of the ball, waits on it and ramps it over Jitesh. Good start for Bawa
Length ball outside off, tucked to midwicket
Shepherd goes for the wide yorker. Doesn't quite nail the length, but successfully keeps it out of Bawa's swinging arc
On a length outside off, blocked back to the bowler

Easy pickings for Bethell and Jacks is walking back to the dugout. On a length outside off and Jacks looks to whip it away. Doesn't come off the middle at all and the ball goes high towards deep midwicket. Bethell runs in, settles under it, and takes an easy catch. Mumbai Indians lose a fifth
Length ball outside off, Tilak works it down to long-on

Back of length and angled into him, Jacks backs away and pulls this wide of long-on. Krunal has to run across and dive and he manages to keep it down to two. Just six runs off the over. RCB will take it
Jacks backs away to this back-of-length delivery and looks to cut it away but can't beat backward point
Length ball outside off, blocked to midwicket
Length ball jags in from outside off, Jacks pushes at it and the ball lobs into the vacant midwicket area. They pick up two
Cramps him with a back-of-length delivery. Tilak backs away and punches it towards long-on
Shorter side of good length outside off and angled across. Tilak goes across to scoop but misses. Jitesh goes up in appeal, but the umpire gives it wide. RCB don't review
Back of length on leg, 140.2kph, Tilak parries it down
Goes short outside off, taking Tilak by surprise. Tilak hangs back and adjusts late to clip it to long-on
On a length outside off, Jacks eases it down to long-on
On a length outside off, chopped towards point for a quick run
Tilak keeps going! He took on Krunal an over before this, and now he's taken on Suyash with the slog-sweep. Tossed up in the slot and Tilak hammers it over midwicket
Floated full outside off and drifting in, Jacks knocks it down towards long-on
On a length on leg, tucked to deep midwicket

Outside edge goes past the keeper. Streaky boundary to start off for Jacks. Full outside off, and Jacks pushes at it. Gets a thin edge that bounces short of the keeper diving to his right and dribbles away
beaten! Wafts at a length ball outside off and the ball swooshes past the outside edge
Full outside off, driven to cover

Knocks him over! Two boundaries and a wicket. Cross-seam length ball outside off stays low and skids through as Dhir swipes across the line and knocks off the leg stump. That's a big breakthrough just as MI got a partnership going
Oh, so smartly played! Dhir uses the pace on this length ball and opens the face of the bat to steer this in the gap between backward point and short third
Cracking shot. Waits on this length ball outside off, and punches it away through the covers
On a length on leg, he backs away and punches it down to long-off
Tilak works this full ball down to long-on
Full on leg, clipped square on the leg side
Length ball angled across him, he looks to cut and chops it past the wicketkeeper
Massive! This is floated full outside off and Tilak nails the slog sweep. Sends this into the stands over square leg
Fullish and angled down leg, clipped to deep square leg
On a length outside off, clipped to deep midwicket. Good comeback from Shepherd after being hit for a six first ball
Length ball angled in from outside off, tucked to deep square leg
Back of length outside off, Tilak cuts to backward point
Full on leg, Dhir works it down to long-on
On a length outside off, blocked to the off side
Oh, what a shot. Length ball angled in from outside off and Dhir picks it early and swings it over square leg
Pushed quicker at 99kph and down leg, he scythes this to deep backward square leg
Flatter outside off, Tilak wrists this to deep midwicket for a run
Flatter on off, Dhir steps forward and pushes to long-off
Pushed quicker down leg stump, he steps across and works this to deep midwicket
Flatter outside off, he hops back and cuts to the right of Bethell at deep backward point. Tilak gets back for two
Darted 97.5kph length ball on the pads of Dhir who turns this to deep midwicket
Pushed quicker on a length on middle, he eases to long-on
Oof, the inside-edge saves him. Was the skiddy shortish ball on off stump, Dhir looks to pull and gets a thick inside-edge onto pad
A clean strike over long-on and Dhir gets six. Floated on the fuller side of length on off stump, he bends low, gets under it and deposits him deep and long
Googly on off stump, he pushes to the left of Patidar at extra cover and sets off
Flatter outside off stump, he drives on the up to deep extra cover
Gently tossed up outside off, he pushes to long-on

Length ball on middle stump, he works this to deep backward square leg where Kohli collects and fires a flat throw. Oh, oops, the ball hits the edge of the pitch and bounces over Jitesh's head. But there was backup in place
There's the Krunal bouncer. But it's a wide on height. Was banged into the surface but way over Tilak's head. Jitesh has done really well
Fuller in length on off, he stays legside of the ball and eases to long-off
An 87.3kph length ball on middle and leg, he steps across and turns this to deep backward square leg
Flatter outside off, he pats this to point and wants a run but is sent back
Overthrows get Tilak two more. Slower on off stump, he works this to wide long-on where Kohli fires a direct hit at the striker's end and concedes an extra run
Slower length ball on off and middle, he gets across and works to deep square leg with soft hands for two
Round-armish hard length ball on leg stump, he works this to the on-side around the square leg region for a run
Back of a length ball outside off, he punches to backward point and Dhir has to sprint to make it home
Hurries Tilak again with a short ball on leg. He gloves a pull to the right of Jitesh who can't get there in time
On a length outside off, he drives to extra cover's left who parries to mid-off
Close again! Sharp hard length ball on middle stump. The ball gets big on Tilak, who fends at it right from the top of the bat and also presents a return catch to Shepherd
Back of a length ball outside off, he flat-bats this to the right of David at deep square leg
Slower back of a length delivery angling away from Tilak who misses his attempted guide

Suyash Sharma has shelled a straightforward catch. Slower short of a ball on leg stump. Tilak charges down the track but is deceived by the change of pace. He splices a simple chance to the left of Suyash at midwicket. He runs, for some reason dives, and makes a meal of it
On the bounce to Bethell at deep square leg. Banged in short on middle, the ball gets big on him as he mistimes a pull. Bethell runs in but can't reach it
Nudged down leg and he gets four more. Cross-seam but wayward length ball down. He gets on top of the bunce and gets a slight tickle to the left of the keeper. He gives chase but to no avail
Short of a good length ball on the stumps, he works this to midwicket

A misfield from Shepherd and Tilak gets four. On a length outside off, he punches to the right of extra cover, where Shepherd over-runs the ball and Tilak got enough power behind the shot to go to the boundary
Length ball on off stump, he ticks this to midwicket
Delightful! On a length with hint of nibble outside off stump, he drives on the up and threads the gap in the covers
Fullish in length on off stump, he pushes to mid-off and sets off
Length ball just outside off, Tilak stays legside of the ball and shimmies down the track to guide this to the left of deep backward point for a couple of runs
On a length on off stump, he defends to the offside
Oof, that's as close as you can get to a hat-trick. On a length on off stump, shaping away late. Tilak is beaten
Length ball on off, he pushes to point and sets off only to be sent back by Tilak
Picked for four. Length ball on leg stump, he heaves it to the left of deep backward square leg and there's not much Bethell can do there
Back of a length ball outside off stump, Tilak rides the bounce and steers to deep point
Sharp short of a good length ball on middle and leg, he looks to pull and gets hit on the thigh pad
Length ball just outside off, he chops this back onto the pitch
Fullish in length outside off, he slices to backward point

But he won't be getting any this game. My word! SKY has fallen for a first-ball duck. A typical Bhuvi dismissal this. Lands the ball on a length just outside off, shaping the ball away from SKY late. He pushes at it, gets a thick outside edge, with the ball travelling to Kohli's right at slip. He takes a good catch and RCB are buzzing. Bhuvi is on fire; MI are in disarray.

Bhuvi has another. The swing merchant has been taking us on a nostalgia trip all season and here he is at it again. Gets rid of Rohit. A knuckle ball from Bhuvi, as he dangles it on a length well outside off. Rohit stretches forward, pushes at it but can only get a thick outside edge. Jitesh dives to his right and takes a lovely catch. Kohli is pumping his fists. RCB are on top
Beats short third, beats deep backward point and gets four more. On a length outside off, he allows the ball to move and then slices to the right of short third
Sliced for a couple of runs. On a length outside off shaping away from Dhir, he throws his hands at it and carves to deep backward point
On a length outside off, he takes a couple of steps down the track and pushes to covers with soft hands. Is off for a run but sent back by Rohit. Krunal doesn't collect cleanly
Fullish in length on off, he pushes to mid-off
Wayward length ball down leg, called a wide

Pulls again, and despite not getting the direction to his liking, the result is what he'll care about. Shimmies down the pitch to the short of a length ball, pulls, gets a top-edge that flies over the 'keeper's head and all the way
Pulled for six over a leaping Bethell! Here comes the famous Rohit pull, and he collects maximum. Banged in short on middle, he gets enough bat on it to clear deep backward square leg
JAFFA! Length ball that lands just around off, and shapes away late past Rohit's outside edge. You'd be unlucky to get an edge on that
Length ball down leg, clips his pad down to the deep fine leg area for a two leg-byes

Just over mid-off and the ball skips away for four. Not off the middle of the bat but will do. Back of a length ball outside off, he shimmies down the track and even as the bat turns in his hand, he gets it over mid-off
On a length outside off stump, Rohit watches closely and shoulders arms. I don't think I have ever typed this in a T20 game

This time it is straight to Patidar. What a start for RCB! Good length ball on off stump, Rickelton wants to loft this over mid-off, but doesn't get it anywhere near the middle. The ball floats to Patidar, who takes the simplest of catches at mid-off
Decks the length ball back into Rickelton rapping him on the thigh pad as he misses the flick
Close again. Length ball jagging back into Rohit on off. He chops it back onto his pad towards slip with the two taking a quick run
Length ball decking away from Rickelton outside off, he punches to sweeper cover
On a length outside off, he pushes to covers and sets off

Ooh, just short! Wowza! A hint of swing  but the ball also stops in the surface. Was a length ball outside off, Rickelton is through his shot early and the ball floats to mid-off, where Patidar leaps and dives forward but can't reach it

RCB get over the line in the most dramatic of finishes! Mumbai Indians' IPL 2026 dreams come crashing down. Full outside off, Rasikh punches this straight back. Bawa gets a hand on it to slow this down on it's way to long-on. They race for the first run and scamper for the second. Rasikh puts in the dive and is back just in time. RCB, after two defeats on the trot, have won a see-saw contest to get another 'W' to their name. MI and LSG are knocked out, and RCB go top of the table!
This is a slower ball and Bhuvneshwar miscues it down to long-off. They just manage a single

Bhuvi has creamed this over cover! Bhuvneshwar Kumar takes on this yorker outside off and goes inside out and hits it over a leaping Naman Dhir! What a shot, that, from Bhuvneshwar Kumar! The crowd erupts!
Bawa greets Bhuvneshwar with a bouncer that sails over his head. Called wide

Sliced to backward point, and surely that's over for RCB! Bawa goes full around off and Shepherd almost swings himself off his feet as he looks to go over the leg side. But all he manages is an outside edge and it's a simple catch for Tilak. Bawa is a relieved figure, Shepherd is mad
Oh, that's well bowled. Goes for the yorker outside off, and Shepherd can't get bat on it. Bawa thinks he may have edged it and has a polite inquiry
Oh my. Goes for the wide yorker, and ends up missing the line. It'll be a wide and the batters raced through to get Shepherd back on strike! A direct hit would have seen Shepherd gone as well!
That's done really well by Bawa. Goes on a length and angled across and it stays low. Shepherd still manages to toe-end it to deep midwicket. Just a single, though
This time he does nail the yorker outside off. Shepherd can only dig it back to the bowler. Oh wait, he's overstepped! It's a no-ball and we'll have a Free Hit coming up!
Looks to take it away from his arc, but ends up bowling a wide! Shepherd reached out for it but it was too far away

Shepherd misses again! Full and angled into the pads, Shepherd looks to whip it away but can't connect. They do get a leg bye as the ball deflects through cover point but Bumrah has bowled a sensational 19th over!

Oh Bumrah, you absolute beauty! Nails the yorker and Shepherd is all at sea as he brings his bat down. The ball bounces behind to the keeper and they can't even sneak in a run. What a bowler this guy is, eh?

Bumrah goes full. Shepherd swings and misses and Bumrah raps him on the pad. Bumrah appeals, and before he can complete his appeal is already asking SKY to review this with the umpire unmoved. Rickelton thinks it was missing leg, but they have reviewed nonetheless. Looks like Rickelton was right, that was sliding down leg by a fair bit!
Short ball angled in from outside off, Shepherd ducks under
Back of length outside off, he waits on it and steers it down to deep third
Looks for the yorker around off, clipped through square leg

Tilak now does the relay catch all by himself! Full outside off and Krunal hits it flat to long-on's left. Tilak runs across, takes the catch, throws the ball up before crossing the rope and then hops back over to complete the catch. He grabbed it at first go a fair bit away from his body, and that's pretty great fielding. He makes up for his little gaffe from earlier in the over. Although, the 12 runs scored in between could still prove crucial. RCB, however, have lost their set batter. Krunal walks off after a spirited 73, fighting not just the opposition but also cramps

Krunal Pandya you beauty! He is on the floor again, but before he got there, he has everyone at the ground on their feet with a stunning slog. Not quite a slot ball but he reaches out and hammers it over cow corner
Swipes this length ball through square leg. They don't run, with Krunal cramping up
Krunal fighting on here! This time he nails the slog against this length ball and hammers it over long-on. He's instantly on the ground and stretching again but he's keeping RCB right in this

Oh boy, that's a mess-up! Krunal looks for the slog sweep and gets a top edge. Naman Dhir and Tilak converge from deep midwicket and long-on respectively. Dhir takes the catch but sees he's going over the rope and tosses it towards Tilak, who was caught ball-watching and misses the ball completely. Tilak seems to signal that he saw Dhir's foot go over which is why he didn't bother but apologises later on. Check shows he got rid of the ball in time
Starts with a ball on a good length that spins in. Krunal pushes it out towards cover
Short ball angled across, pulled to deep midwicket for a single
Gets cramped for room as he looks to pull. The ball lobs to deep midwicket on the bounce
Punches a length ball down to long-off's right
On a length outside off, Shepherd eases it through point
Short ball angled across, Krunal pulls this out to deep midwicket on the bounce

Now the slower bouncer does Krunal in! Early into the pull and he cops a blow. He falls to the ground but also seems to cramp up. Immediately asks Rickelton for some assistance and Rickelton holds his right leg up at full stretch till the RCB physio gets out there
Goes for the bouncer across Krunal, but that's a wide for sure. Krunal watches it sail over

Oh, Bosch has two in two! David's gone first ball! Cross-seam delivery jags in from outside off and David is early into the pull. The ball deflects off the toe end of the bat and Rickelton catches it to his right
Skied to deep point! Tries to cut away a short ball outside off and ends up slicing it. Easy catch and RCB lose another wicket. Bosch has a third!
Oh, stunning from Jitesh! Gets inside the line of this short ball and hooks it very fine on the leg side and it goes all the way
Looks to swing this away leg-side again. Bounces well short of deep square leg
Full outside off, driven to mid-off
Boom! Overpitched outside off and flicked away with disdain over midwicket!
On a length outside off, he runs this down to deep third
Swings at this full delivery outside off. Doesn't hit it cleanly but still well enough to pick up two runs and reach a well deserved fifty in a tricky chase
Full outside off, flicked to midwicket
Full around middle, blocked back out to Bumrah's right
On a length outside off, punched down the ground
Bumrah welcomed with a cracking shot! This is back of length outside off, and he waits on it before punching it away through cover
Full on the pads, clipped away wide of long-on. Tilak, stationed there, runs to his left and makes the stop
Looks for a slower wide bouncer, but it's called wide again
Now he goes too short on the bouncer. Will have to rebowl that
Short ball sits up nicely and Krunal Pandya cashes in! Swings hard and hammers this away through square leg. He waited on the slower ball and picked it superbly
Steers this length ball through point for a single

Jitesh gets one out of the screws! Six dot balls after coming out to bat, and he finally connects and how! This is overpitched around middle, he gets leg-side of the ball and lofts it handsomely over long-off
Full around off, blocked back to the bowler
Back of length outside leg, swung away through to long leg
Ouch! Length ball rises sharply and raps Jitesh on the gloves. Wicket maiden for Bosch!
Back of length outside off, dropped towards point
Length ball outside off angling in, blocked towards mid-on
Full around off, blocked back towards the non-striker
On a length outside off, Jitesh stands tall and blocks it down

Oh, straight to the fielder! This is a hit-me ball, overpitched around middle and leg. Bethell looks to flick it away but can't get the requisite power behind the shot. Straight to Tilak Varma, who holds on
Gets low to this length ball and paddles it to deep square leg
Taps this length ball into the vacant midwicket region
Floated on middle, he looks to whip it away but gets a leading edge that dribbles through point
Slightly short and angled across him, Krunal pulls it along the ground to long-on
Smoked over cow corner! Gets a stride forward to this slot ball and nails the hit down the ground
Full around middle, clipped into the vacant midwicket region
Back of length delivery angled across, Krunal dabs it towards backward point for a quick run
Skips out to this slower bouncer and has a swipe but can't connect
On a length outside leg, tucked through square leg
Chops this length ball behind point for a single
Handsome from Pandya! This is overpitched outside off and Krunal lofts it down the ground, straight of mid-off. Holds the pose, does Krunal
Back of length ball angled into him, Bethell helps it along to long leg
Flatter length ball outside off, he pushes to deep cover for a run

Big, big appeal for lbw. Rickelton is convinced that hit Krunal's pad first and then bat but the umpire stays unmoved. Will MI review? Surya does with three seconds left on the clock. Skiddy length ball outside off, that did hit Krunal's pad onto bat to short third but the impact was outside off. So, MI lose a review. There was also a chance for a run out at the striker's end and a direct hit would have found Krunal short, I think. End result, they only geta run via an overthrow
BANG! Krunal gets four. Floated on the stumps right in KP's arc. He smokes that to the left of the bowler
Slower through the air and also gets some turn. Was on middle and leg, he looks to flick that away but only manages a thick inside-edge onto pad to the offside
Darted on leg stump, rather just outside. He eases this to long-on
Pushed quicker on leg stump, he flicks this to deep backward square leg
Charges down the track to the tossed up ball on leg stump, but only gets it as far as long-off
Pushed quicker again on middle and leg, he flicks this neatly to deep backward square leg
Flatter and down leg, called a wide
He's absolutely crrrrrunched that! Tossed up on middle, he brings out the sweep and smokes it to the left of deep midwicket
Nicely done but only for a run. Flatter outside off stump, he stays back and cuts to the right of deep backward point
Fuller on the stumps, he gives himself room and shimmies down the track but pushes only as far as extra cover
Slower through the air on middle stump, he works this to deep square leg
On a length on middle and leg, he flicks to short midwicket
Oh, ouch! Flush into the midriff. Bosch is working up good speeds. Hard length that lands on off and hurries back into KP hitting him on the stomach
On a length on off, he pushes to backward point and sets off

Oh, miscommunication again and once again an MI fielders throws it to the wrong end. Hard length ball cramping Pandya for room. He ticks this to the on-side and while Bethell was off for a run right away, KP wasn't sure. Raghu running from square leg, went at the striker's end and missed
On a length outside off, he punches through covers for a run

Oh, think Bawa went at the wrong end. Angles the length ball into Krunal on off, he pushes to backward point and Bethell was off straight away. Krunal, however, stuttered a touch. Bawa threw it to the striker's end and his throw was wide
Slightly short on the stumps, KP goes back and works this to deep midwicket
Gently tossed up on middle stump, beats Krunal's inside-edge and thuds into his midriff
Marginally short on middle stump, he rocks back and thumps that all along the turf to the sub fielder Minz. He went the wrong way initially, but recovered in time
Shimmies down the track to the tossed up delivery outside off and drives to the left of extra cover
Gently floated on off stump, with some spin away from Krunal. He prods forward and pushes to backward point
Gets some turn first up on the tossed up ball outside off. Bethell drives through covers
Back of a length ball outside off stump, he looks for a cut and misses. Not called a wide, but that was quite close to the tramline
Ooh, Bosch gets the good length ball on off to jag back into Krunal. The ball thuds into his gloves and through to slip on the bounce

HOOKED FOR SIX! KP in the house. Banged in short on leg stump, he gets inside the line of that and helps it effortlessly over the deep backward square leg region for a 77m six. Looks like we have a lost ball. The fourth umpire brings out a new set of balls.
Whacks that away but can't beat backward point. Short and wide outside off, he smokes the cut but can't beat the fielder
Back of a length ball outside off, Krunal punches through covers for a couple of runs to get off the mark

Straight up, straight up and Bosch's hard length has paid dividend right away. Cross-seam delivery on off stump, Patidar wanted to pull that away but only manages a big top-edge that balloons straight up with Rickelton doing the rest
On a length with a hint of nibble outside off, he pushes to backward point for a run to end the fifth

Dropped in his followthrough. Was a very tough chance with Chahar only getting a hand to it. Fuller outside off, he pushes aerially to the right of Chahar, who flings out his right hand but the ball doesn't stick
Length ball outside off stump, he punches to deep backward point off the backfoot
Short, wide and punished by RaPa! Well outside off stump and Patidar thrashes this over point's head to collect his first boundary
Oof, Patidar negotiated that inswinger really well. Chahar goes fuller and pushes the indipper on off stump. Patidar brings out the full face of the bat and defends
Good length ball outside off stump shaping away from Patidar. He looks to force that through covers, mistimes it
Lots of pace and bounce for Bumrah. Back of a length ball outside off stump at 138kph, Bethell throws his hands at it but the ball flies over his blade
Fuller but down leg this time around, called a wide
Off the hip for two leg-byes. Short of a good length ball down leg, he misses the flick as the ball goes towards deep fine leg
Length ball outside off stump, he opens the face of the bat to steer to deep third
Banged in short on middle and leg, but that is too high as Patidar ducks under
Squares him up does Bumrah, but Bethell gets off strike. On a length just around off stump, shaping away from Bethell. He is opened up as he gets a thick outside edge to deep third
Length ball on middle and leg, he works this to the right of square leg to get off the mark
Sharp good length ball down leg, thuds into Bethell's gloves with the ball going behind square on the leg side

The swing of Chahar gets MI another wicket and Padikkal is now walking back. Length ball at 132kph that lands just around off stump and shapes away late. DDP is caught in the crease pushing at it with an angled bat. He gets a thick outside edge and Rickelton does the rest. MI are making an early dent and RCB are suddenly nervous.
CARVED away for six. Back of a length ball outside off stump, he flashes at it and flashes hard. The ball flies over the deep third fence

Huge appeal from Chahar and the keeper but the umpire remains unmoved. No review from MI. Fuller outside off stump, DDP jumps down the track looking to throw Chahar off his length. He jams his bat into the ground and misses the ball
That keeps a little low. Skiddy back of a length ball angling away from DDP outside off. He looks for a pull but misses
On a length nibbling away from DDP outside off, he stabs at it with an open face of the bat to the gully fielder
Lovely shape for Chahar and DDP is in Test mode for the moment. Length ball that lands around off stump and shapes away late. DDP watches closely and shoulders arms
Length ball on off stump decking back into DDP, who steers this late to deep third
On a length outside off stumping tailing away from DDP who shoulders arms
Fuller on off stump, he presents the full face of the bat and pushes to the right of mid-on
Length ball on middle and leg, he ticks this to the leg side
Thuds the good length ball on Bethell's bottom glove on leg stump. They take a run to the on-side

There is an appeal from Bumrah for caught  behind, nothing from the slip and the keeper. And more importantly, nothing from the umpire. MI don't review. Rising short of a good length ball just outside off, shaping away from Bethell. He feels for it and misses.
Easy pickings. Length down leg, Chahar tickles that fine to get off the mark with four
Ooh, what a first ball to get. Lands the length ball just around off and shapes it away late past DDP's outside edge

A golden duck for Virat Kohli. Just what MI would have hoped for and Raipur has been silenced. Fullish in length shaping away from Kohli outside off, he shimmies down the track looking to clear mid-off. He doesn't time that at all and Bawa runs to his right at mid-off and takes a good diving catch. Back to back ducks for Kohli.
Big swing for Chahar but the line is well outside off stump, Kohli lets that go. Rickelton fumbles to his right but no harm done, apart from the wide
On a length just outside off, he pushes to backward point and sets off

Oof, all class! Kohli would be proud of that cover drive. Oh, yes, he has a big smile on his face as he punches gloves with Bethell. Full angling away from Bethell outside off, he leans forward and plays the most perfect cover drive with poise, panache and all that jazz
That is a perfect start for RCB and Bethell. Length ball seaming into Bethell on middle and leg, he flicks this effortlessly to the left of mid-off
